system.sensesNotes: Darkvision 120 ft, Devil's Sight, True Sight 120 ft
system.attacksNotes:
Entropic Strike [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 10 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 15 damage (8 + 7 Str) + 5 Negative damage (Half DR).
  • Margin 2: 15 damage, DR halved (round up) + 5 Negative damage; target Weakened + Sickened + loses 6 from Current Luck; no save; target makes Fortitude [Easy] save or gains 1 Exhaustion level.
  • Margin 3: 15 damage, DR halved (round up) + 5 Negative damage + all conditions; Exhaustion level; no save; target also loses 1 point of Constitution permanently until Major Restoration.

Void Lance [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 3 + Ranged Combat 6), Range: 150 ft, 10-foot diameter.

  • Margin 1:: 20 Negative damage (17 + 3 Dex) + Weakened for 1 minute.
  • Margin 2: 20 Negative damage, DR halved (round up) + Weakened + Sickened for 1 minute + loses 4 from Current Luck; no save.
  • Margin 3: 20 Negative damage, DR halved (round up) + all conditions + 1 Exhaustion level; no save.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Entropic Presence: Creatures within 20 feet that are not Fiends make a Fortitude [Hard] save at the start of their turn. Failure: lose 2 from Current Luck and gain the Weakened condition until end of their next turn. Infernal Command: Any Fiend of equal or lower TR within 1 mile that is not already under another creature's control must make a Will [Hard] save at the start of each of their turns or follow the Pit Caller's instructions instead. This includes other summoned Fiends if the summoner's Cooperative or Friendly disposition bond is not actively maintained. Call from the Pit (1/day) [Combat]: As 2 [Combat] actions, tears a rift to the lower Negative plane in a space within 60 feet. From this rift emerge 4 Gnashers and 2 Shadow Hounds, and 1 Tormentor at the start of the Pit Caller's next turn. These creatures are not under the summoner's control — they are under the Void Fiend's control, and the Void Fiend directs them as it chooses. The rift closes after 1 minute. The summoner's Summoning Limit does not apply to these creatures as they are not summoned by the summoner. Void Compulsion (1/encounter) [Combat]: As 2 [Combat] actions, the Void Fiend exerts its full will on all creatures within 60 feet that are not Fiends. Each creature makes a Will [Hard] save. Failure: Charmed by the Void Fiend for 1 minute; treats it as a trusted authority whose instructions must be followed. 1 success: Frightened for 1 minute. Creatures immune to charm still suffer the Frightened result on 1 success. Bargain: The Void Fiend can offer the summoner a deal at any point during the summoning. The terms it proposes will appear favorable. The terms it proposes will technically be favorable. The way those terms interact with the summoner's existing obligations, future plans, and the Void Fiend’s own longer strategy is something the summoner should evaluate very carefully before accepting. Immunity to Non-Magical Weapons. Immunity to Fire Damage Resilient Defense (3/day): When the Void Fiend fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Negative Energy Sharing: The summoner and up to 4 designated allies gain immunity to the Weakened and Sickened conditions while within 60 feet. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
